// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the client.
Code* (string)::
Client identifier (client_id) used in the OAuth requests.
Tenant (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Owner tenant. Empty for a global client, manageable only by the root tenant.
Allow all scopes (boolean)::
Lets the client request any scope instead of only the standard OpenID Connect ones.
Token endpoint auth method* (OauthClientTokenEndpointAuthMethodOptions)::
How the client authenticates at the token endpoint: client secret in the Authorization header or in the body, a signed JWT (private_key_jwt), or none for public clients.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * client_secret_basic
 * client_secret_post
 * private_key_jwt
 * none

Token endpoint auth signing alg (string)::
Algorithm the client uses to sign the JWT with which it authenticates at the token endpoint.
Dpop bound access tokens* (boolean)::
Requires the access tokens of this client to be bound to a DPoP key (RFC 9449).
Id token signed response alg (OauthClientIdTokenSignedResponseAlgOptions)::
Algorithm used to sign the ID tokens issued to this client.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * RS256
 * ES256
 * EdDSA

Tls client auth subject dn (string)::
Expected subject DN of the client certificate for mutual-TLS client authentication (RFC 8705).
Tls client certificate bound access tokens* (boolean)::
Binds the access tokens of this client to its TLS client certificate (RFC 8705).
Authorization signed response alg (string)::
Algorithm used to sign JWT-secured authorization responses (JARM) for this client.
Backchannel token delivery mode (OauthClientBackchannelTokenDeliveryModeOptions)::
How tokens are delivered in the CIBA flow: the client polls the token endpoint, or receives a ping.Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * poll
 * ping

Backchannel client notification endpoint (string)::
Endpoint of the client that receives the CIBA ping notifications.
Subject type* (OauthClientSubjectTypeOptions)::
Subject identifier sent to the client: the same for every client (public) or a different one per sector (pairwise).Los posibles valores que toma el campo son:
 * public
 * pairwise

Id token encrypted response alg (string)::
Key management algorithm used to encrypt the ID tokens of this client; empty sends them unencrypted.
Id token encrypted response enc (string)::
Content encryption algorithm used to encrypt the ID tokens of this client.
Userinfo encrypted response alg (string)::
Key management algorithm used to encrypt the userinfo responses of this client; empty sends them unencrypted.
Userinfo encrypted response enc (string)::
Content encryption algorithm used to encrypt the userinfo responses of this client.
Authorization details types (blob)::
JSON list of the authorization_details types the client can request (RFC 9396).
Userinfo signed response alg (string)::
Algorithm used to sign the userinfo responses; empty returns them as plain JSON.
Secret oauth (string)::
Client secret; only its digest is stored.
Registration access token (string)::
Token the client uses to manage its own registration (RFC 7592); only its digest is stored.
Default acr values (string)::
Authentication context class (ACR) values requested by default when the client does not send acr_values.
Default max age (integer)::
Maximum authentication age, in seconds, applied when the client does not send max_age.
Sector identifier uri (string)::
URL listing the redirect URIs of the clients that share pairwise subject identifiers.
Allowed login redirects (xref:#entidad-oauth-client-allowed-login-redirect[OauthClientAllowedLoginRedirect])::
Redirect URIs the client may use after sign-in.
Allowed logout redirects (xref:#entidad-oauth-client-allowed-logout-redirect[OauthClientAllowedLogoutRedirect])::
Redirect URIs the client may use after sign-out.
Allowed audiences (xref:#entidad-oauth-client-allowed-audience[OauthClientAllowedAudience])::
Audiences (resource servers or resource URIs) the client may request tokens for.
Grant types json (blob)::
JSON list of the grant types the client may use.
Introspection allowed* (boolean)::
If true, this client is allowed to call the token introspection endpoint (POST /introspect) to validate access tokens. Resource servers must authenticate at the introspection endpoint using their client credentials.
Require pushed authorization requests* (boolean)::
Requires the client to send its authorization requests through PAR (RFC 9126).
Require pkce* (boolean)::
If true, every authorization code request from this client must include code_challenge and code_challenge_method=S256. For clients with public-allow=true, PKCE is always required regardless of this flag.
Backchannel logout uri (string)::
Endpoint of the client that receives back-channel logout notifications.
Backchannel logout session required (boolean)::
Includes the session identifier (sid) in the back-channel logout token.
Frontchannel logout uri (string)::
URL of the client loaded in the browser to sign the user out (front-channel logout).
Frontchannel logout session required (boolean)::
Adds the issuer and session identifier to the front-channel logout URL.
Enabled* (boolean)::
A disabled client cannot sign in users or obtain tokens, without deleting it.
Client name (string)::
Name of the client shown to users, for example on the consent screen.
Logo uri (string)::
URL of the client logo shown to users.
Client uri (string)::
URL of the home page of the client.
Policy uri (string)::
URL of the privacy policy of the client.
Tos uri (string)::
URL of the terms of service of the client.
Response types json (blob)::
JSON list of the response types the client may request.
Dynamically registered (boolean)::
The client was created through dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).
Registered at (datetime)::
When the client was registered.
Client credentials scopes (blob)::
Scopes granted to the client in the client credentials flow.
Client credentials token ttl seconds* (integer)::
Lifetime, in seconds, of the access tokens issued in the client credentials flow.
Request object signing alg (string)::
Algorithm the client must use to sign request objects.
Jwks uri (blob)::
URL of the JSON Web Key Set with the public keys of the client.
Jwks json (blob)::
JSON Web Key Set with the public keys of the client, when it does not publish a jwks-uri.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de oauth client para controlar bloqueos optimistas
